lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately 10-12 identifiable vertical columns starting posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a discernible grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge extends along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light upper surface and shadow below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor notches are visible along the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin and irregularities are present on the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible attached to the ventral region near the base of the left pectoral fin.
